replaces.idea: A grounded cast-iron route signpost with stacked directional blades pointing toward neighboring networks.
A desktop rotary Rolodex on a weighted base with a side knob and fanned index cards.

A tied canvas dispatch parcel with a bright wax seal resting on a small wooden sorting tray.
